title: sutera tenuifolia
intro: Sutera tenuifolia, commonly known as blue throatwort, is a plant species that belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
